Answer: I do some exercise every day to stay healthy and active.
Answer translate: Men sog‘lom va faol bo‘lish uchun har kuni mashq qilaman.
Reason: Because it helps me stay fit and improves my health.
Reason translate: Chunki bu meni sog‘lom qiladi va sog‘lig‘imni yaxshilaydi.
Example: For example, I usually go jogging or do stretching exercises in the morning.
Example translate: Masalan, men odatda ertalab yuguraman yoki cho‘zilish mashqlari qilaman.
Extra Info: Also, it gives me energy for the whole day.
Extra Info translate: Bundan tashqari, bu menga kun bo‘yi energiya beradi.

Answer: I do housework at home to help my family.
Answer translate: Men oilamga yordam berish uchun uy yumushlarini qilaman.
Reason: Because I want to keep my home clean and organized.
Reason translate: Chunki men uyimni toza va tartibli saqlashni xohlayman.
Example: For example, I clean my room, wash dishes, and sweep the floor.
Example translate: Masalan, men xonamni tozalayman, idish yuvaman va pol supuraman.

Answer: I do the shopping on weekends when I am free.
Answer translate: Men bo‘sh bo‘lganimda dam olish kunlari xarid qilaman.
Reason: Because it is more comfortable when I have free time.
Reason translate: Chunki bo‘sh vaqtim bo‘lganda bu qulayroq.
Example: For example, I buy food, drinks, and household items.
Example translate: Masalan, men ovqat, ichimlik va uy uchun narsalar sotib olaman.
Extra Info: It helps my family save time.
Extra Info translate: Bu oilamga vaqtni tejashga yordam beradi.

Answer: I do some work in the evening after my classes.
Answer translate: Men darslardan keyin kechqurun ish qilaman.
Reason: Because I am busy during the daytime.
Example: For example, I complete my tasks and check my emails.
Example translate: Masalan, men vazifalarimni bajaraman va elektron xatlarni tekshiraman.
Extra Info: It helps me improve my skills.

Answer: I do my homework after school every day.
Answer translate: Men har kuni maktabdan keyin uy vazifamni qilaman.
Reason: Because my teachers give me homework regularly.
Reason translate: Chunki o‘qituvchilar menga muntazam uy vazifa berishadi.
Example: For example, I write exercises and learn new grammar rules.
Example translate: Masalan, men mashqlar yozaman va yangi grammatik qoidalarni o‘rganaman.
Extra Info: It helps me learn better and get good grades.
Extra Info translate: Bu menga yaxshi o‘qishga va yuqori baho olishga yordam beradi.

Answer: I make future plans for my education and life.
Answer translate: Men ta’limim va hayotim uchun kelajak rejalari tuzaman.
Reason: Because I want to have a successful future.
Example: For example, I plan to study at university and learn English well.
Example translate: Masalan, men universitetda o‘qish va ingliz tilini yaxshi o‘rganishni rejalashtiraman.
Extra Info: It motivates me to work harder.

Answer: I make a to-do list every morning before starting my day.
Answer translate: Men har kuni ertalab kunimni boshlashdan oldin vazifalar ro‘yxatini tuzaman.
Reason: Because it helps me stay organized.
Reason translate: Chunki bu meni tartibli bo‘lishga yordam beradi.
Example: For example, I write my homework, chores, and other tasks.
Example translate: Masalan, men uy vazifa, yumushlar va boshqa ishlarni yozaman.
Extra Info: It helps me not forget important things.
Extra Info translate: Bu muhim narsalarni unutmaslikka yordam beradi.

Answer: I stay in for the evening when I feel tired.
Answer translate: Men charchagan paytimda kechqurun uyda qolaman.
Reason: Because I want to relax and rest at home.
Reason translate: Chunki men uyda dam olishni xohlayman.
Example: For example, I watch TV or listen to music.
Example translate: Masalan, men televizor ko‘raman yoki musiqa tinglayman.
Extra Info: It helps me relax after a long day.
Extra Info translate: Bu menga uzoq kundan keyin dam olishga yordam beradi.

Answer: I eat healthy food every day to stay strong.
Answer translate: Men kuchli bo‘lish uchun har kuni sog‘lom ovqat yeyman.
Reason: Because it is good for my body and health.
Reason translate: Chunki bu mening tanam va sog‘lig‘im uchun foydali.
Example: For example, I eat fruits, vegetables, and drink water.
Example translate: Masalan, men meva, sabzavot yeyman va suv ichaman.

Answer: I have an early night when I am very tired.
Answer translate: Men juda charchagan paytimda erta uxlayman.
Reason: Because I need enough sleep for my body.
Example: For example, I go to bed at 9 or 10 pm.
Example translate: Masalan, men soat 9 yoki 10 da uxlayman.
Extra Info: It helps me wake up fresh in the morning.
Extra Info translate: Bu menga ertalab tetik uyg‘onishga yordam beradi.

Answer: I sometimes go to bed late when I have a lot of work.
Answer translate: Ba’zan ko‘p ishim bo‘lganda kech uxlayman.
Reason: Because I need to finish my tasks first.
Reason translate: Chunki men avval vazifalarimni tugatishim kerak.
Example: For example, I study or finish homework at night.
Example translate: Masalan, men kechasi o‘qiyman yoki uy vazifani tugataman.
Extra Info: It makes me feel tired the next day.
Extra Info translate: Bu keyingi kuni charchoq his qilishga olib keladi.

Answer: I have fun when I spend time with my friends.
Answer translate: Men do‘stlarim bilan vaqt o‘tkazganimda ko‘ngil ochaman.
Reason: Because it makes me happy and relaxed.
Reason translate: Chunki bu meni baxtli va xotirjam qiladi.
Example: For example, we play games or go out together.
Example translate: Masalan, biz o‘yin o‘ynaymiz yoki tashqariga chiqamiz.
Extra Info: It reduces stress and improves mood.
Extra Info translate: Bu stressni kamaytiradi va kayfiyatni yaxshilaydi.

Answer: I have a good time when I go to parties or trips.
Answer translate: Men ziyofat yoki sayohatga borganda yaxshi vaqt o‘tkazaman.
Reason: Because I enjoy spending time with people.
Reason translate: Chunki men odamlar bilan vaqt o‘tkazishni yoqtiraman.
Example: For example, we dance, talk, and take photos.
Example translate: Masalan, biz raqsga tushamiz, gaplashamiz va rasmga tushamiz.

Answer: I have a family meal every Sunday with my family.
Answer translate: Men har yakshanba oilam bilan ovqatlanaman.
Reason: Because family time is very important for me.
Reason translate: Chunki oila vaqti men uchun juda muhim.
Example: For example, we eat together and talk about our week.
Example translate: Masalan, biz birga ovqatlanamiz va hafta haqida gaplashamiz.

Answer: I have a lie-in on weekends because I don’t go to school.
Answer translate: Men dam olish kunlari maktabga bormaganim uchun kech uyg‘onaman.
Reason: Because I want to rest after a busy week.
Reason translate: Chunki men band haftadan keyin dam olishni xohlayman.
Example: For example, I wake up around 10 or 11 am.
Example translate: Masalan, men soat 10 yoki 11 da uyg‘onaman.
Extra Info: It helps me feel more relaxed.

Answer: I go on a trip in summer with my family.
Answer translate: Men yozda oilam bilan sayohatga boraman.
Reason: Because I love exploring new places.
Reason translate: Chunki men yangi joylarni kashf qilishni yoqtiraman.
Example: For example, we visit mountains or different cities.
Example translate: Masalan, biz tog‘larga yoki boshqa shaharlarga boramiz.
Extra Info: It gives me new experiences and memories.
Extra Info translate: Bu menga yangi tajriba va xotiralar beradi.

Answer: I go shopping with my friends on weekends.
Answer translate: Men dam olish kunlari do‘stlarim bilan xaridga boraman.
Reason: Because it is fun and enjoyable.
Example: For example, we buy clothes and shoes.
Example translate: Masalan, biz kiyim va poyabzal sotib olamiz.
Extra Info: We also spend good time together.

Answer: I chat with my friends online every day.
Answer translate: Men har kuni do‘stlarim bilan onlayn gaplashaman.
Reason: Because we live far from each other.
Example: For example, we use social media and messaging apps.
Example translate: Masalan, biz ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va xabar ilovalaridan foydalanamiz.
Extra Info: It helps us stay in touch.
